github.connectedDesc: Your GitHub account has been linked.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.dialogDescription: Are you sure? This will permanently delete your account and all data. This cannot be undone.

verifyEmail.title: Check your inbox
verifyEmail.description: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it below.

forgotPasswordPage.title: Reset your password
forgotPasswordPage.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset code.
forgotPasswordPage.sentNotice: If an account exists for that email, a code has been sent.

resetPassword.title: Set new password
resetPassword.description: Enter the code sent to {{email}} and your new password.
resetPassword.successDesc: You can now sign in with your new password.

toasts.waitForCode: Wait a moment before requesting a new code.
toasts.signInWithNew: You can now sign in with your new password.

acceptOnSignUp: By creating an account you accept the <terms>terms and conditions</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

enroll.title: Set up two-step verification
enroll.description: Every account needs an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
enroll.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
enroll.cantScan: Can't scan it? Enter the key manually
enroll.typeCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.
recoveryCodes.saved: I have saved my recovery codes
recoveryCodes.fileNote: Each code can be used once. Generating new codes invalidates these.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to continue.
